figurative_meaning_en: Starting or initiating a task or project
example_sentences_in_bangla: নতুন বছরে আমরা ব্যবসার গোড়াপত্তন করব।
example_sentences_in_english: The foundation of this company was laid in 1950.
We will initiate our business at the start of the new year.
note: This idiom draws from the concept of establishing a base, common in Bengali administrative and literary contexts.
